# Workspace Instructions

- This is a Next.js app using TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and the App Router.
- Use npm for package management and the scripts in package.json for local development, build, and linting.
- Keep changes minimal and consistent with the existing app structure.
- Prefer editing source files under src/ and keep public assets in public/.
- If you add new UI, keep it responsive and aligned with the existing design system.
